import hashlib, json
claims = [
    (112107027, 1018699967, 8149599737, 256, 1134913534),
    (819310576, 1032750773, 30982523191, 1073741824, 21367783975),
    (873153835, 1084101493, 36859450763, 17179869184, 23363711307),
]
residues, checksums = [], []
for i,(x, mod, p, g, h) in enumerate(claims, 1):
    ok = pow(g, x, p) == h
    print(f"R{i} check: {ok}")
    assert ok
    residues.append(x)
    s = f"dlog-2x2-v1:independent-{i}:{x}"
    checksums.append(hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest())
with open('answer.json','w') as f:
    json.dump({"residues": residues, "checksums": checksums}, f)
print(json.dumps({"residues": residues, "checksums": checksums}, indent=2))
EOF
